thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks fall premarket, led by United Technologies and McDonald's - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks fall premarket, led by United Technologies and McDonald's - MarketWatch
text: All 30 of the Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, +0.58% components' shares were falling in premarket trade Wednesday, as worries over the escalation of a trade war with China weighed on the broader stock market. Dow futures YMU8, -0.71% slid 164 points. The biggest Dow decliner was United Technologies Corp.'s stock UTX, +0.30% which fell 2.4%, followed by the 1.2% decline in both McDonald's Corp. MCD, +0.43% shares, and the 1.2% slide in 3M Co.'s stock MMM, +0.47% The most active Dow stock ahead of the open was Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -0.12% which shed 0.8% on volume of over 186,000 shares.
